title: SWIFT: Sample-Wise Instance Fine-Tuning of Time-Series Foundation Models for Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.17915v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While current few-shot adaptation strategies for time series forecasting foundation models are predominantly dataset-centric, the necessity of obtaining an additional dataset for the finetuning process poses a significant hurdle for adoption. To address this constraint, we propose Sample-Wise Instance Fine-Tuning (SWIFT), a novel forecasting adaptation framework that achieves fine-grained specialization by leveraging structural priors from the target instance's own history. This shift allows the fine-tuning process to be entirely transparent to the end-user, which significantly enhances the ease of adoption. To implement this framework, SWIFT synergizes Self-Retrieval for historical mining and Frequency-Aware Loss for spectral consistency, while employing Deviation-Aware Dynamic Fusion to balance adaptation with general knowledge preservation. Extensive experiments across four TSFM backbones and three long-history benchmark subsets valid

translated_title: SWIFT：面向预测任务的时间序列基础模型样本级实例微调
translated_abstract: 当前针对时间序列预测基础模型的少样本适配策略主要以数据集为中心，而微调过程需要获取额外数据集这一要求给模型的推广应用带来了重大障碍。为解决这一限制，我们提出了样本级实例微调（SWIFT），这是一种新颖的预测适配框架，通过利用目标实例自身历史中的结构先验来实现细粒度的专门化。这一转变使得微调过程对最终用户完全透明，显著提升了模型应用的便捷性。为实现该框架，SWIFT 协同运用自检索进行历史挖掘、频率感知损失保证频谱一致性，并采用偏差感知动态融合来平衡适配能力与通用知识的保留。在四个时间序列基础模型骨干和三个长历史基准子集上进行的广泛实验验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: SWIFT 提出了一种样本级实例微调框架，利用目标时间序列自身历史中的结构先验，无需额外数据集即可对时间序列基础模型进行对用户透明的细粒度微调，显著降低了模型适配的应用门槛。
en_tdlr: SWIFT is a sample-wise instance fine-tuning framework that adapts time-series foundation models by leveraging structural priors from the target instance's own history, requiring no additional dataset and remaining fully transparent to end-users, thus greatly easing adoption.
